Dearest[Jay](/person/1042)[^1]
Thank you – here are a few hardly worth it
Your affec

C M Yonge


[^1]: Two other affectionate letters to a cousin addressed as Jay exist (MSS Charlotte Mitchell), and from internal evidence the most likely recipient seems to be Jane (Colborne) Montgomery Moore.
